description: Repairs r-str-ado-act/create-ado (and ado2, ado3, ado4): fixture tables were lost to DAO DDL refusals (DECIMAL, unbracketed Note) and the Decimal column made by DAO CreateField had Precision 38. Fixture r-fix-wire-ado-ado5, created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128), closed, then built through an ADO connection (Provider ACE) by DDL and INSERT with SQL literals, each statement's Connection.Errors read right after it: K(ID COUNTER primary key, Code TEXT(10) unique, L LONG, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, N DECIMAL(18,4), Dt DATETIME, T TEXT(50), M MEMO, B LONGBINARY) with four rows (a1 full, a2 Code only, b3 zero/empty, b4 extremes), J(ID LONG key, KID LONG referencing K(ID), [Note] TEXT(20)) with two rows, D(N LONG) with ten rows; every table is then read back through ADO. Then DAO reopens the file, writes B of row a1 through a dynaset Edit, creates saved queries QParam (one Text parameter) and QEmpty, refreshes QueryDefs and reads their names. Asks which statements succeed and what each table, row and query holds.

args.text: CREATE TABLE K (ID COUNTER CONSTRAINT PK_K PRIMARY KEY, Code TEXT(10) CONSTRAINT UX_K_Code UNIQUE, L LONG, D DOUBLE, C CURRENCY, N DECIMAL(18,4), Dt DATETIME, T TEXT(50), M MEMO, B LONGBINARY)
INSERT INTO K (Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, T, M) VALUES ('a1', 1, 1.5, 2.25, 3.125, #2024-01-02#, 'alpha', 'memo one')
CREATE TABLE J (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_J PRIMARY KEY, KID LONG CONSTRAINT FK_J_K REFERENCES K (ID), [Note] TEXT(20))
SELECT ID, Code, L, D, C, N, Dt, T FROM K ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, KID, [Note] FROM J ORDER BY ID
SELECT Count(*) AS Cnt FROM D
SELECT B FROM K WHERE Code = 'a1'
PARAMETERS pCode Text(10); SELECT ID, Code, T FROM K WHERE Code = pCode;
